name: Pennsylvania: Pennsylvania Uniform Construction Code (UCC), residential

review.note: Adopts IRC 2021 (Department of Labor & Industry; 34 Pa. Code § 403.21(a)(7)). State amendments to the checked rules: riser height, tread depth. Amendments were researched for stairs, ceiling height, light and ventilation only; every other rule (room size, egress, escape openings, electrical, alarms) is the base code's.
